# 1408. String Matching in an Array

## Solution 1 (time O(n^2), space O(1))

```python
class Solution(object):
    def stringMatching(self, words):
        """
        :type words: List[str]
        :rtype: List[str]
        """
        ans = []
        for i, w1 in enumerate(words):
            for j, w2 in enumerate(words):
                if i != j and w1 in w2:
                    ans.append(w1)
                    break
        return ans
```
